With `optimization.model_snapshot_index="flat"` and MultiIndex snapshots, model creation still passes the original `sns` to `define_secant_loss_constraints`, but now calls it inside `flat_snapshots_context(n, True)`. That context makes component-array reads flatten their snapshot coordinates, so its per-snapshot line data is read in flat representation rather than the MultiIndex representation of the supplied snapshots.
